text: The track of a horse in the soft earth
why: Paragraph 117 says a horse's track was plainly outlined in the soft earth, and the shoe fitted it.

text: Thursday evening, at the long hollow towards Mapleton
why: They set off on Thursday morning (¶13) and reached Tavistock by evening (¶47). The sun is setting (¶113) as they walk to the hollow towards Mapleton (¶116–117).
